start.text: (Tanvi at a table outside the café, a cold coffee half gone.) Your profile photo is a bus. Bold. Sit — I ordered for you. Filter coffee. You looked like a filter-coffee person.

city.text: So. First year in Bangalore. Let me guess: a PG, then a flat, and the flat has one bar of signal and a cot.

choices.text: Ambedkar Nagar. On a hill. The signal goes there to die.

hill.text: Pune girl, same first year, two years ago. A terrace room in Koramangala with a water tank for a neighbour. It gets better. Then it gets weird. Then it gets better.

guitar.text: Your profile says 'guitar, three chords'. Which three?

gcd.text: The holy trinity. You'll be playing at weddings by March. (She laughs at her own joke first, which somehow makes it funnier.)

bill.text: (The bill arrives on a little steel plate: ₹480.)

she_pays.text: I did say that. Fine. Next one's yours.

bye.text: (At the metro stairs, a quick hug.) Text me when you reach. I mean it — this city eats people at night.
